slides.texte_overlay:
How to bring happiness
back into your days
Start the day with something you enjoy. A good coffee on the balcony, music while you shower. Small pleasures set the tone.
Move your body outside. A run in the park, a bike ride, a swim. Exercise outdoors is one of the fastest mood boosters there is.
Clean up your space. A tidy room makes your mind feel lighter. Start with one drawer if everything feels too much. Small wins count.
See people who make you laugh. Laughter changes your mood in minutes. Plan time with the funniest people you know. Book it this week.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A little wonder every day makes ordinary days feel brighter.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A little wonder every day makes ordinary days feel brighter.

slides.texte_overlay: Do something kind for someone. Help, give, encourage. Making others happy is one of the surest ways to feel happy yourself.
End the day by writing one good moment. Even on hard days, there's usually one. Noticing it trains your mind to see the good.
